$comment: Vehicle motion and size assumptions. Keyed by route key, falling back to mode defaults. Sources: 'guess' unless noted; see regions/metro-vancouver/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #9, #12, #13. accel/decel in m/s², speeds in km/h, lengths/widths in metres. 'minCruiseFraction': when the schedule allows more time than needed, run no slower than this fraction of maxSpeed and hold the remainder as extra dwell at the origin (packages/transit-core/DESIGN.md#movements-and-playback). 'dwell' is used when GTFS arrival == departure (true for all SkyTrain stops).

expo.$comment: guess: mix of 4/6-car Mk I, 4-car Mk III and 5-car Mk V (~85 m, 12 sets in service Sep 2026; CPTDB). OPEN-QUESTIONS #9

millennium.$comment: guess: 4-car Mk II (Millennium runs Mk II only, 2 or 4 cars; CPTDB). OPEN-QUESTIONS #9

canada.$comment: 2-car Hyundai Rotem EMU, the only Canada Line stock (CPTDB). OPEN-QUESTIONS #9

sizing.$comment: Vehicles are drawn to true scale when zoomed in, but never smaller than this many pixels long, so they stay visible at city zoom.
